question.worked_solution:
First, recall that:

$$
{lim}_{s\to 0}f(s)=[\begin{aligned}{lim}_{s\to 0}\sqrt{s+8} \\ {lim}_{s\to 0}\frac{\operatorname{arcsin}⁡s}{s} \\ {lim}_{s\to 0}(1+2s)^{1/(2s)}\end{aligned}]
$$

Now, we find the limits one-by-one.

- For the first component, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{s\to 0}\sqrt{s+8} & =\sqrt{0+8} \\  & =\sqrt{8} \\  & =\sqrt{{2}^{3}} \\  & =2\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}
$$

- The second component can be found using L'Hopital's Rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{s\to 0}\frac{\operatorname{arcsin}⁡s}{s} & ={lim}_{s\to 0}\frac{{(\operatorname{arcsin}⁡s)}^{′}}{{s}^{′}} \\  & ={lim}_{s\to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{s}^{2}}}}{1} \\  & ={lim}_{s\to 0}\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{s}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{0}^{2}}} \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$

- The third component can be found using a special limit:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{s\to 0}(1+2s)^{1/(2s)} & ={lim}_{u\to 0}(1+u)^{1/u}=e\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, ${lim}_{s\to 0}f(s)=[\begin{aligned}2\sqrt{2} \\ 1 \\ e\end{aligned}].$
